changeinfo.changes:
Following features are added.
  • Flying Guide functionality is now always accesible although you can only use it to get first badge of each stage.
  • Adjustments made in Tumbili's trace when flying.
  • A new option added in Pause menu to mute Tumbili's voice when explodes.
  • Game logo and some images of the game has been updated.
  • Minor fixes.
